::: {#def-bfs}
#### Breadth-first search

Let $G$ be a graph (@def-graph-vertices-edges) or a directed graph (@def-directed-graph) with no parallel edges (@def-parallel-edges),
given by an adjacency list (@def-adjacency-list), and let $s$ be a vertex of $G$.
**Breadth-first search** [@wikipedia_breadth_first_search] from $s$ is the algorithm (@def-algorithm) `bfs`,
written in the pseudocode of @rem-pseudocode:

```text
procedure bfs(G, s)
    mark s, and set dist[s] := 0
    Q := a queue containing only s
    while Q is not empty
        v := remove the front of Q
        for each vertex u in the list of v, in order
            if u is not marked
                mark u, and set dist[u] := dist[v] + 1
                add u to the back of Q
```

Here $Q$ is a queue (@def-queue),
and `dist[u]` is a label that the algorithm gives to $u$ when it marks $u$.

:::
